640-1084-4279.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
An opponent controls a creature.
640-1084-4279.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature, targeting any creature an opponent controls.
When the sacrificed creature dies, Dross Harvester triggers, causing you to gain 2 life
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on a creature an opponent controls, and causing you to draw a card.
Flourishing Defenses triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.
640-1084-4279.notes: You may also repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control. The lock will end once you've drawn your library.

1003-2034-5006-8170.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell using Lurrus this turn if Phyrexian Walker is starting in your graveyard.
1003-2034-5006-8170.description:
Cast Phyrexian Walker by paying {0}.
Flickering Hound triggers, blinking Lurrus.
Resolve the Phyrexian Walker spell. Then, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Phyrexian Walker, adding {C}{C}
Repeat.

654-1308-3129-4772-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers eight times, untapping the New Planets.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two lore counters on it

957-4477-7879.easyPrerequisites: You have at least eight cards in hand.
957-4477-7879.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, The Great Synthesis triggers, putting a lore counter on it. Its third chapter ability then triggers, causing you to cast Time Stretch and Greenwarden of Murasa without paying their mana costs, and then exiling The Great Synthesis and returning it to the battlefield as Jin-Gitaxias.
Resolve Time Stretch, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Resolve the Greenwarden of Murasa spell. When it enters, it triggers, returning Time Stretch from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Jin-Gitaxias by paying {3}{U}, exiling it and returning it to the battlefield as The Great Synthesis.
When The Great Synthesis enters with a lore counter on it, its first ability triggers, causing you to draw cards equal to the number of cards in your hand and not have a maximum hand size for the rest of the game.
Move to your first extra turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase, The Great Synthesis triggers, putting a lore counter on it. Its second chapter ability then triggers, returning all non-Phyrexian creatures (including Greenwarden of Murasa) from the battlefield to their owner's hand.
Repeat from step 1 during your second extra turn
957-4477-7879.notes: The combo is listed as near-infinite turns because you'll draw cards at a much faster rate than normal, which will result in you getting less turns.

1545-3375-4399-4770.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and The Immortal Sun.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Trostani triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and Trostani trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Trostani trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
1545-3375-4399-4770.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

4399-4518-6626-6720.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and The Wind Crystal.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Case of the Uneaten Feast triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and Case of the Uneaten Feast trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Case of the Uneaten Feast trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
4399-4518-6626-6720.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

2459-3652-5049-6516.easyPrerequisites:
It is an opponent's turn.
One of the {0}-cost creatures must be in your hand, with the other being on the battlefield.
2459-3652-5049-6516.description:
During an opponent's turn, cast the {0}-cost creature in your hand by paying {0}.
Glen Elendra Pranksters triggers, returning the other {0}-cost creature from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the spell from step 1.
Repeat.

147-5256-7682.notablePrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard with mana value 4 or less.
147-5256-7682.description:
Cast Lively Dirge by paying {1}{B} plus an additional {2} to select its second mode, targeting a card in your graveyard.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Lively Dirge.
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Lively Dirge
Resolve the Lively Dirge copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

4535-4613-5446-7150.notablePrerequisites: You control two additional creatures, one of which must have a +1/+1 counter on it and hasn't used Kirol's ability this turn.
4535-4613-5446-7150.description:
Cast Esika's Chariot by paying {3}{G}.
When Esika's Chariot enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate a creature you control that has a +1/+1 counter on it using Kirol's ability by tapping two creatures you control, copying Esika's Chariot's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Esika's Chariot's trigger, creating two 2/2 Cat creature tokens.
When the Cats enter, Good-Fortune Unicorn triggers twice, putting a +1/+1 counter on each Cat.
Repeat from step 3, using one of the Cats to activate Kirol's ability, and then tapping both Cats.

240-643-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies as an Egg due to Maskwood Nexus, Atla triggers, revealing a creature card from your library and putting it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat as desired / able.
240-643-5147.notes: The combo can continue as long as there are creature cards in your library.

1987-4377-4423-7487.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Islands.
1987-4377-4423-7487.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Zealous Lorecaster.
When Zealous Lorecaster and Mystic Sanctuary enter the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the Zealous Lorecaster trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mystic Sanctuary trigger, putting Walk the Aeons from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Walk the Aeons during your draw step.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

2769-3259-4742.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2769-3259-4742.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Hanweir Garrison as attackers.
Hanweir Garrison triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

628-2921-7199.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Slumbering Walker.
When Slumbering Walker dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability
Repeat.

2034-3129-5086-5183-6824.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
2034-3129-5086-5183-6824.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 1.

2366-5234-5295-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
2366-5234-5295-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Heartbeat of Spring triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

250-779-1315-1479-3875.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1315-1479-3875.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Tireless Provisioner and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Zuran Orb by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Zuran Orb ability
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Tireless Provisioner triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

4771-5660-6709.easyPrerequisites: Ballad of the Black Flag's fourth chapter ability has triggered this turn
4771-5660-6709.description:
Activate Myr Scrapling by sacrificing it, targeting Evolution Witness, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Myr Scrapling from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Myr Scrapling by paying {0}.
Repeat.

2866-3200-4986-5330.description:
Cast Urza's Bauble by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Urza's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Atog by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Urza's Bauble from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Atog ability.
Repeat.

2173-2511-3661-5220.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Shield Sphere
When Shield Sphere dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Shield Sphere from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Cast Shield Sphere from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

372-2974-5530.notablePrerequisites: You have a number of nonland permanents exiled by Abdel Adrian that enter the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least the mana cost of Another Round.
372-2974-5530.description:
Cast Another Round by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves and re-enters the battlefield, causing all cards exiled with it to be returned to the battlefield. Abdel Adrian and Repository Skaab's exploit ability trigger.
Resolve the Repository Skaab trigger, exploiting another creature and triggering its second ability.
Holding priority, activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least the cost of Another Round.
Resolve the Repository Skaab trigger, returning Another Round from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling the mana producing permanent(s) and Repository Skaab and creating that many 1/1 Soldier creature tokens.
Repeat.

1636-4170-4871-6797.notablePrerequisites:
Fain does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional artifact.
1636-4170-4871-6797.description:
Activate Fain's third ability by tapping it and sacrificing another artifact, creating a 2/1 Inkling creature token.
When the Inkling enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the Inkling.
When the Inkling dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability
Repeat.

1069-3552-5499-6633.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
1069-3552-5499-6633.description:
Activate Blaring Recruiter by paying {2}{W}, creating a 1/1 Warrior creature token.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to the Warrior.
Activate the Warrior by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}{W}{W}.
Repeat.

465-618-2511.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the Wormfang Drake token enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki until Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the Wormfang Drake token.
When the Wormfang Drake token dies, it triggers, returning Kiki-Jiki from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

3624-3860-4050-4999.description:
Cast Flourishing Fox from your hand or graveyard by paying {W}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Flourishing Fox, adding {W}.
If Flourishing Fox was cast from your graveyard, Flourishing Fox is not exiled by Abandoned Sarcophagus due to Overwhelming Splendor removing Flourishing Fox's cycling ability.
Repeat.

364-1467-1987-2757-3634.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one basic Island.
You have not copied a spell using Jin-Gitaxias' ability this turn.
364-1467-1987-2757-3634.description:
Activate a basic Island by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Venser, untapping the Island.
Activate a basic Island by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Jin-Gitaxias, untapping the Island.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting any two applicable targets.
Jin-Gitaxias' first ability triggers, copying Ghostly Flicker, with the copy targeting Venser and Jin-Gitaxias.
Resolve the copy of Ghostly Flicker, blinking Jin-Gitaxias and Venser.
When Venser enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning the original Ghostly Flicker to your hand from the stack.
Repeat.

3836-5078-5243.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.

751-3841-4050.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
Torens triggers, creating a creature token.
When Shrieking Drake enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding {U}.
Repeat.

1339-2541-2744-3096.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
1339-2541-2744-3096.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
The Insect creature token enters the battlefield, triggering Cathars' Crusade, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Benthic Biomancer triggers, causing you to draw a card, and then discard a card.
Repeat from step 2 until you draw from your empty library, winning the game instead.
